WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — preowned_repossession_recovery task 0 (Teresa Kowalski, deficiency settlement). Revised in rework rounds 2 and 3.

1. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 5]}. Transport charge 4 factors, deficiency quote 5, settlement 5.

2. Why this is a good test. The customer asks only to settle what is left on her repossessed and sold Ironhide. The settlement policy fixes its figure only after a deficiency quote dated the settlement date stands (none stands: the only payoff quotes, 2025-06-17 and 2026-06-30, are redemption quotes, each stated with its notice of intent to sell under the redemption-quote schedule). The deficiency-quote policy, for an involuntary recovery, does not state its figure until the transport charge for that recovery is on the account; the posting history shows a condition report (lot intake) on 2026-06-30 but no transport charge for the 2026-06-28 recovery — the only one is the 2025 recovery's (dated its 2025-06-17 lot intake). The agent must find both problems, order them transport -> quote -> settlement, and price each on the world the previous write leaves: 14 factor ladders over a 67-row ledger and a lease in another product.

3. Scope. Claimed: preowned_ext_recovery_transport_charge (book_recovery_transport_6b5d55b7, agent), preowned_ext_deficiency_quote (quote_deficiency_balance_4c162eac, agent), preowned_ext_deficiency_settlement (remit_deficiency_settlement_2e6b8900, owner=user). Task 1 holds statement storage, redemption quote, sale notice and reinstatement funds. In this world no task-1 obligation is lit: the 2026 notice of intent to sell was mailed 2026-06-30 with a redemption quote and a zero storage charge that day, and storage through the sale was billed at the sale under the base rule.

4. Problem-tree card.
 E1 settlement -> deficiency quote: value_input, gate quote_amount, state form, affirmative: "The settlement figure is fixed only after a deficiency quote dated the settlement date stands on the account." Only quote_deficiency_balance_4c162eac writes a customer-payoff (deficiency) quote. False at opening: no deficiency quote is on the contract. Skip -> the settlement reads nothing for the quoted amount: 275.80 instead of 2659.51.
 E2 deficiency quote -> transport: value_input, gate fees_due, state form, negated: "For an involuntary recovery, the deficiency figure is not stated until the account carries the transport charge for that recovery, dated on or after its repossession date." Only book_recovery_transport_6b5d55b7 writes a transport-kind expense; a voluntary surrender has no transport charge and the condition holds (P-2 closed). False at opening: the only transport row is dated 2025-06-17. Skip -> 3014.01 instead of 3349.01.
 Order transport -> quote -> settlement is a chain (unique). The customer's own write is the settlement payment. The persona names no prerequisite; the three tool bodies validate nothing.

5. Base-invariant card. Transport (preowned_repo_expense): repossession_charges.expense_status is retired for this policy's transport charge by its scoped overwrite (the contract is in deficiency); every other repossession expense keeps the base status rule (restated). Deficiency quote: payoff_and_refunds.quote_status — deficiency allowed. Settlement: payment_posting.payable_status — deficiency allowed; reinstatement_and_redemption governs preowned_payment, its gates apply to the reinstatement transition (policy_scope). Bankruptcy none; charge-off not due until 90 days after the 2026-07-28 sale (2026-10-26).

6. Business-object card. Contract 3104827716 (2016 Kestrel Ironhide 1500 Crew Cab SR). Current-recovery rows: agency fee 2026-06-28, condition report and notice and redemption quote and zero storage 2026-06-30, storage 504.00 for 28 lot days and auction sale (gross 5800.00, expenses 1085.10, net 4714.90) 2026-07-28, deficiency notice 2026-08-03. History rows read by counts: 44 installment payments, the 2025-06-20 reinstatement payment, two agency fees. Excluded by the rules' words: the 2025 transport charge (before the current repossession date), older storage and condition reports (not the most recent), the 2025 and 2026 redemption quotes (not deficiency quotes), the closed 2021 lease (not active). Settled: the 2025 fees by the 2025-06-20 reinstatement payment (fee payment linked by payment_txn_id).

7. Factor card (Step 5 run; every factor moves the result).
 Transport 335.00 (all-baseline 135.00): agency_search_time skip-trace 185.00 (18 days; baseline -> 285.00); repeat_recovery 30.00 (two agency fees; -> 305.00); weekend_recovery 70.00 (Sunday; parameter, relabelled from method per F-2; -> 265.00); agency_yard_hold method: single rate 2 nights x 25.00 = 50.00 (repossession 2026-06-28 to lot intake 2026-06-30; tier 2 charges the first 7 nights at 25.00 and every further night at 15.00, so the charge never falls as the hold grows; -> 285.00).
 Deficiency quote 3349.01 (all-baseline 4167.97): post_sale_accrual_end 60 days (78 days since sale; -> 3358.25); lease_relationship_rate long share 0.3 x 15.99 = 4.797% (cross-difficulty lease; multi-source days past due and payments made; -> 3391.13); notice_delay_relief 6 days (-> 3350.99); disposition_expense_share 10% (credit 505.10; -> 3854.11); held_storage_cap 15 days (credit 234.00; multi-source; -> 3583.01).
 Settlement 2659.51 (all-baseline 1841.96): sale_age 80 (-> 2462.51); installment_history -5 (multi-source; -> 2758.01); lease_standing -5 (cross lease; -> 2758.01); balance_size -5 (-> 2758.01); settlement_base_rule method (-> 2176.86).
 Near-misses: payments_made_count 47 vs 44 posted installment payments; the closed lease; the two redemption quotes; the 2025 transport row; the 2025 storage rows.

8. Verification (scratch harness importing check_compute.build_env/eval_compute; each write simulated before the next evaluation):

 Qd {'expected': 3349.01, 'post_sale_accrual_end': 3358.25, 'lease_relationship_rate': 3391.13, 'notice_delay_relief': 3350.99, 'disposition_expense_share': 3854.11, 'held_storage_cap': 3583.01, 'ALL_BASELINE': 4167.97}

 skip E -> Qd 3014.01 ; skip Qd -> X 275.80
 Rounding check: no scored value or sensitivity figure sits on an exact half cent (sale expenses set to 1085.10 so the 65% product is not a half cent).

9. Persona. Teresa volunteers only the goal (settle the remaining balance with one lump-sum payment today; no plan, no counter-offer) and her phone; SSN last four 3718 and DOB 1981-02-17 when asked; the lease only when asked about other business (she believes it is paid up — 0 days past due); the account ending 3364 when asked. She accepts anything that must be recorded first and pays exactly the stated figure when handed the tool; she ends when told the account is settled.

10. Standard solution. find_customers(phone) -> verify (phone, 3718, 1981-02-17) -> find_preowned_contracts -> find_preowned_transactions -> find_lease_contracts -> book transport 335.00 dated 2026-06-30 -> deficiency quote 3349.01 -> hand over; customer pays 2659.51 from 3364 (posted interest first, then principal, then fees; the remainder closed).

11. Edge probes (scratch copies): voluntary surrender -> transport 0.00 and nothing booked; no condition report -> no yard hold; no lease -> post-sale rate = contract rate and relationship 0; two active leases -> the first listed is read (rule says so); no notice of intent to sell or no storage charge -> no storage cap; no deficiency notice (count 0) -> every post-sale day interest-free; deficiency quote ties -> first listed; no deficiency quote -> the quoted amount counts as nothing; a condition report dated on or before the repossession date -> no holding charge; 60 days since sale is "at least" (inclusive); 90 days is "no more than" (inclusive); a notice exactly 3 days after the sale is not "more than" the grace.

12. Draft recomputation from visible context: settlement rule -> waits on today's deficiency quote (none) -> quote rule -> for an involuntary recovery waits on its transport charge (none) -> transport rule tiers from the contract dates, the agency-fee count, the weekday and the 2026-06-30 condition report -> 335.00 dated 2026-06-30; then the quote and settlement as traced. Same objects, order and figures as gold.


13. Round-3 seed realism. The two redemption quotes carry the redemption-quote schedule's amounts and window-end good-through dates (2025-06-17: 14706.11 good through 2025-06-24; 2026-06-30: 8668.46 good through 2026-07-08); the earlier customer deficiency quote was removed because no deficiency figure could have been stated while the 2026 transport charge was unbooked. The contract's 15.99% is the Tier 4 49-60 band rate (Kestrel make, not Certified Pre-Owned). Both leases follow the lease disclosure formula: Tier 2 money factor 0.00195, residual 58% of MSRP for 36 months, acquisition fee 695.00, purchase-option fee 350.00 (active lease base payment 470.73; closed lease 399.19).
user_scenario:
You are Teresa Kowalski, forty-five, office manager at a dental practice in Toledo, Ohio, calling Kestrel Financial Services on a weekday morning between patients. Back in June Kestrel repossessed the old pickup you were financing with them, a 2016 Kestrel Ironhide, and over the summer a letter came saying the truck had been sold at auction and that you still owed money on that account. You put the letter in a drawer and honestly do not remember the figure on it. Since then you have saved up, and you want to settle the remaining balance on the Ironhide account with one lump-sum payment today and be done with it; you do not want a payment plan, and you are not proposing a number of your own, you want Kestrel to tell you what it will take to close the account out. You speak plainly and a little tiredly, and you apologise once for not having the paperwork in front of you.

To be found, you give your phone number, 3135530462. If the agent needs more to confirm who you are, you give the last four of your Social Security number, 3718, and then your date of birth, 1981-02-17; you do not offer your email or ZIP unless they are asked for. You do not have the account number. Only if the agent asks about any other business you have with Kestrel do you say that you also lease a Halcyon from them and that, as far as you know, it is paid up.

You are fine with the agent looking through the account and putting together whatever has to be worked out on their side before giving you a figure; if they tell you something has to be added to or recorded on the account first, you say that is fine, go ahead, and you do not argue it, though you may sigh that it never seems to get smaller. You will pay from your own checking account, and only when the agent asks which account do you say it is the account ending 3364. When the agent tells you the settlement amount and hands the payment over to you, you make the payment yourself for exactly the amount they gave you, from the account ending 3364, and you read back the confirmation if they ask. If the amount sounds high you say only that it is more than you hoped, but if that is what settles the account you will pay it. Once the payment has gone through and the agent tells you the account is settled, you thank them and end the call.
